title: Health & Nutrition: Hydration
welcome_lead: Even mild dehydration drops performance — drink up.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: hydration, signs of dehydration, water intake.

concepts.def: Having enough water in the body.

walkthroughs.body_html: You lose water in sweat, breath and urine. Even a 2% loss hurts performance and focus.
Dark urine, dry mouth, headache, tiredness, dizziness. By the time you're thirsty, you're already low.
Water is fine for most sport. For long, sweaty sessions, drinks with electrolytes and a little sugar can help.
